title: The potter at dawn
alt: A ceramic artist shapes a clay vessel with one hand inside the rim and one supporting its outer wall.
description: Natural hand interaction, wet clay and warm workshop lighting in a detailed documentary scene.
prompt: A sophisticated close documentary photograph of an adult ceramic artist shaping a tall terracotta vessel on a turning pottery wheel. The artist's two natural hands work together around the same vessel: one hand lightly supports the outside wall, the other shapes the rim from inside. Wet clay glistens on the fingers, the vessel has a coherent circular opening and smooth continuous walls, and concentric wet rings appear on the wheel head. The artist wears a pale-blue linen apron; a softly detailed workshop with drying pots and a high window recedes behind. Beautiful dawn light, rich tactile clay and fabric, precise anatomy and contact, no words or logos.
